reason: Both ranking variants improve synthetic mean AP, but each loses to NOUL on one seed. Unsafe-up decreases synthetic mean ROC-AUC. External AP does not show a robust unsafe-up advantage, and bidirectional external mean AP is below NOUL. The predeclared requirement of positive AP differences at every seed is not met.
interval_scope: Paired group bootstrap, 1000 resamples, same groups across fixed matched seeds. Conditional on these three seeds and fixed recipe families; not a confidence interval over the population of training seeds or real-world tasks.
protocol_deviation: At explicit user request the selected first-seed checkpoints were evaluated on final tests before all nine checkpoints were frozen. Data, hyperparameters, threshold and validation-based selection were not changed. The later bulk inference exactly reproduced the early logits.
claim_scope: Synthetic mean AP improvement, not confirmed general safety benefit, unique monotonicity benefit, harm prevention or calibrated risk. Bidirectional total regularization weight is not dose-matched to unsafe-up.
